title: Tensor with a fixed right factor preserves zero morphisms.
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site and let $A$ be a sheaf of commutative rings. Fix a universe of modules, independently of the site and ring universes, and assume the hypotheses of the attached Lean declaration, which make the underlying presheaf of rings of $A$ a sheaf and make module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] available: $J$-sheaves of commutative rings remain sheaves after the forgetful functor to rings (in the ring universe), weak sheafification of abelian-group-valued presheaves exists in the module universe, and the morphisms inverted by sheafification of abelian-group-valued presheaves in the module universe are exactly the locally bijective morphisms. Let $N$ be a sheaf of $A$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $T_N$ be the functor obtained by forgetting to presheaves, tensoring sectionwise with the underlying presheaf of $N$, and applying module sheafification [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Thus $T_N(M)=M\otimes_A N$, and $T_N(f)$ is the sheafification of the presheaf map whose component at $U$ sends $x\otimes y$ to $f_U(x)\otimes y$. Then $T_N$ preserves zero morphisms: for all sheaves of $A$-modules $M,M'$, $T_N(0_{M,M'})=0_{T_N(M),T_N(M')}$. This is the functor `SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight N` with the stated independent universes.

source.place: lem-sf-filtered-coefficient-tensor-bounds: the Lean of this node (its declaration uses) reaches SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight_preservesZeroMorphisms, a sorry on the sorry route of batch3, batch4 with no node; Lean: SHEAF file lean/Sheaf/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/SiteTensorFunctoriality.lean, declaration SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight_preservesZeroMorphisms (module Sheaf.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Sheaf.SiteTensorFunctoriality, lines 33-40, proof `sorry`)

proof.text: For $M,M'$ as in the statement, the zero sheaf morphism has zero linear map on every section module, by the definition of module morphisms [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Before sheafification its tensor with $\mathrm{id}_N$ therefore sends $x\otimes y$ to $0\otimes y=0$ at every $U$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Here $0\otimes y=0$ follows by expanding $(0+0)\otimes y$ and cancelling. Every tensor is a finite sum of pure tensors by the construction of the module tensor product, so this linear map is zero. Equality componentwise is equality of presheaf morphisms; consequently the entire presheaf tensor map is zero.

Write $a$ for module sheafification and $\eta_P:P\to aP$ for its unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. For any zero presheaf morphism $z:P\to Q$, naturality gives $a(z)\circ\eta_P=\eta_Q\circ z=0$. The zero module-sheaf morphism $0:aP\to aQ$ has the same composite with $\eta_P$. The unique-factorization clause of module sheafification, applied to the zero map $P\to aQ$, gives $a(z)=0$. This proves the required zero preservation directly, without assuming sheafification is additive.

By the definition of the sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], $T_N(0)$ is sheafification of the presheaf map calculated in step 1. That map is zero, and step 2 shows its sheafification is zero. Hence $T_N(0_{M,M'})=0_{T_N(M),T_N(M')}$ for arbitrary $M,M'$, which is exactly preservation of zero morphisms.
